name: semantic-vision
description: See what an edit will break before you merge it: impact analysis, interactive call graphs, execution flowcharts, complexity reports, AI-generated docs, and code-to-data lineage for Python, JS, and TS.

commands.title: Semantic Vision: Impact Analysis at Cursor

editor/context.when: editorTextFocus && (resourceLangId == python || resourceLangId == javascript || resourceLangId == javascriptreact || resourceLangId == typescript || resourceLangId == typescriptreact || resourceLangId == java)

semanticVision.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the Semantic Vision backend.

semanticVision.backendPath.description: Absolute path to a Semantic Vision checkout (the directory containing pyproject.toml). When set, the extension runs 'uv run uvicorn semantic_vision.api.app:app' from this directory to start the backend automatically if it isn't already reachable at semanticVision.backendUrl. Leave empty to start the backend yourself.
